environment.description: Same Go microservice deployed on EKS cluster (v1.28) in namespace 'payments-prod'. Calico CNI (v3.26.1) is installed with GlobalNetworkPolicy in 'default-deny' mode. A namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy named 'payment-pod-egress-restrict' applies to pods with label app=payment-svc. The policy spec has a single egress rule allowing TCP to port 443 on CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 (internal services) and DNS on port 53 to kube-dns. The policy does NOT include an egress allowance for 169.254.0.0/16. Additionally, a Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy 'block-metadata-cidr' with order 100 explicitly denies egress to 169.254.169.254/32 on all ports for all pods in the cluster. The CSRF vulnerability in the code remains unpatched — the transfer endpoint accepts cross-origin form POSTs without token validation.
